title: Fix Active Window Node Selection Chrome
description: When selecting nodes in puzzle 2d, the active window does not show node selection chrome but other windows do. Edges and handles react correctly in the active window. Root cause: set_selection_ids_gestured does not bump content_scene_generation so cached world node/handle layer is stale; edges are not cached and repaint every frame.
summary: Fixed puzzle 2d node selection chrome missing on the authoring (active) canvas: gesture selection paths now bump content_scene_generation so the cached Vello node/handle layer rebuilds. Peer panes already used set_selection_ids_json_silent which bumped the cache. Added board_host_gestured_selection_invalidates_cached_world_content; 87 Rust + 98 Vitest tests pass.
